content.title: About
content.content: Ground turkey is minced turkey meat containing 93% lean protein and 7% fat. It is sold raw and is versatile for many culinary uses, from patties to sauces.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Turkey is considered a leaner meat compared with beef or pork.
Ground turkey is a popular choice in diet plans because of its low fat content.
In the United States, turkey is a traditional Thanksgiving dish, and its ground form is often used in stuffing.
Turkey meat is rich in tryptophan, an amino acid that helps produce serotonin.
Raw ground turkey should be kept at 4 °C or lower and cooked promptly after thawing.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Ground turkey provides about 22 g of protein per 100 g, supporting muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: With only 7 % fat, it fits well into calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: It contains niacin, vitamin B6, and folate, which are important for metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Contains minerals
items.content: Ground turkey supplies iron, zinc, and phosphorus, essential for blood formation and bone health.

items.title: Very low in carbohydrates
items.content: Practically carbohydrate‑free, making it suitable for low‑carb eating patterns.

items.title: Risk of foodborne illness
items.content: Raw ground turkey can harbor Salmonella or Campylobacter; cook to an internal temperature of 74 °C.

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to bird meat.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: If the ground turkey is seasoned, monitor overall salt intake.

items.title: Storage
items.content: Ground turkey spoils quickly; keep refrigerated and use within 2 days or freeze.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Ground turkey can be sautéed, baked, boiled, or steamed. It is used for burgers, meatballs, vegetable fillings, sauces, and Asian‑style dishes. Adding herbs and spices enhances its flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator at +4 °C for up to 2 days. For longer storage, freeze at -18 °C; it retains quality for 3–4 months. Thaw in the fridge, not at room temperature, before cooking.
